sources.title: OpenVINO/Qwen3-4B-int8-ov · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: This is Qwen3-4B model converted to the OpenVINO™ IR (Intermediate Representation) format with weights compressed to INT8 by NNCF. Quantization Parameters Weight compression was performed using nncf.compress_weights with the following parameters: mode: INT8_ASYM For more information on quantization, check the OpenVINO model optimization guide.

sources.title: Qwen3-4B - Qualcomm AI Hub
sources.snippet: Qwen3-4B State‑of‑the‑art large language model useful on a variety of language understanding and generation tasks. The Qwen3‑4B is a state‑of‑the‑art multilingual base language model with 4 billion parameters, excelling in language understanding, generation, coding, and mathematics.

sources.title: Qwen3-4B-Base: Open-Source 4B LLM with 32K Context & Multilingual ...
sources.snippet: Qwen3-4B-Base is a 4-billion-parameter base language model from Qwen, designed for text generation and conversational tasks. It is pre-trained on 36 trillion tokens across 119 languages with support for 32k-token context length.
